name: @doiiarx/dsh-todo-continuation
description: Todo-backed turn-stop gate and prompt plugin for DeepSeek Harness: vetoes a stop (bounded per turn) while the turn's todo list has unfinished work, and hands the standing list back to the model when it goes un-updated or right after a context compaction - delivered at the stop boundary and mid-turn, measured from the durable session log, so it survives restarts. Configurable in the settings page.

scripts.verify: node --check index.js && node --check client.js && node test/todo-continuation.test.js
